id: 627-第一次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭
theater: 瑪雅山脈至洪都拉斯科潘河谷

battle.name: 第一次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭
battle.theater: 瑪雅山脈至洪都拉斯科潘河谷
battle.brief: 公元六二七年，貝里斯瑪雅山脈北麓的卡拉科爾以聯盟對洪都拉斯科潘河谷的納蘭霍發動「星戰」，聯軍沿古道南進二百餘公里，誘敵出城、破城焚屋，迫其君主交出王像。立於六三一年的納蘭霍第一碑記此事。卡面的秦弩屬中國兵器，從未進入中美洲；真正把攻城者壓在牆外的，是擲矛器、複合弓與投石索。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方是瑪雅低地東南部的城邦與它們各自拉起來的聯盟。進攻方是卡拉科爾（Caracol，碑銘作「三人石之地」，中文資料亦稱卡拉克穆爾），位於今貝里斯凱奧區瑪雅山脈北麓的丘陵台地，核心建築群「天宮」（Caana）高踞台地最高處；其統治家族為 K'inich 王室，以王號與「三人石」標誌發號施令，並長期以「星戰」（xul）的身份向佩滕盆地與科潘河谷方向遠征。防守方是納蘭霍（Naranjo，碑銘名作 Naranj Ha），在今洪都拉斯科潘省科潘河谷內 El Zapotal 一帶的山脊與階梯台地上，建築群沿山勢層層鋪開；其伊察姆坎王朝自六世紀末起便以星戰聞名，先前曾聯手卡安努爾、埃爾佩魯向佩滕方向用兵。六二七年的攻勢由卡拉科爾的「三人石之主」統帥，但真正的兵力來自聯盟：碑銘記下的遠征隊伍由多個城邦的佩槍貴族、弓手與步兵拼成，聯盟城邦的名單與份額決定了這場仗能走多遠。雙方的兵員名冊、損失與戰俘數目都不留於碑刻，現存材料只能確定進攻方向、聯盟的量級，以及勝負歸屬。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were Maya city-states of the southeastern lowlands together with the coalitions each of them had assembled. The attacker was Caracol (written in the inscriptions as the Place of Three Stones, and called Calakmul in some Chinese-language sources), standing on a hilltop terrace in the foothills of the Maya Mountains in the Cayo District of present-day Belize, its core building group, the Caana or Sky Palace, crowning the highest ground; it was ruled by the K'inich royal house, which issued its commands under the royal name and the three-stone emblem and had for generations marched abroad on star wars (xul) toward the Peten basin and the Copan valley. The defender was Naranjo (Naranj Ha in the glyphic texts), spread along the ridges and stepped terraces of the Zapotal zone in the Copan valley of today's Copan Department in Honduras, whose Itz'am K'an dynasty had been famous for its own star wars since the late sixth century and had earlier marched into the Peten in company with Kaanul and El Peru. The offensive of 627 was directed by Caracol's lord of the three stones, but the real strength of the army came from the coalition: the expedition recorded on the monuments was pieced together from the spear-bearing nobles, archers and infantry of a number of city-states, and the list of members and the quotas they contributed decided how far this war could be pushed. Neither headcounts, losses nor prisoner counts survive on the stone; what the surviving material fixes is the direction of the attack, the order of magnitude of the coalition, and which side won.
people: 可點名的人不多，而且多出自碑銘。進攻方由卡拉科爾「三人石之主」領軍，即 K'inich 王室的當世君主；中文百科把這一段的君主列作 Tajoom Uk'ab' K'ak'（約六二二至六三○年在位）與其後的 Yuknoom Head（六三○至六三六年在位），而碑銘學界通常以 K'an Tok Wayib' 為卡拉科爾最著名的君主，其名號橫跨六二○年代末至六八○年代的統治，並與六三一年生擒納蘭霍君主的事件直接相連。防守方是納蘭霍伊察姆坎王朝的君主，學界通常認定六二七年至六三一年在位者為 Chak Tok Ich'aak I，碑刻只以簡寫字形與王冠標誌存其名，形象則多出現在納蘭霍第一碑的畫面裡。真正改變局勢的還有兩類人物：主持「星戰」宣告儀式、決定開戰時機的祭司團，以及在城郊議定聯盟名單、出兵比例、繳獲分配與戰俘贖金條件的王族長老。再往下，是在前線率領佩槍突擊隊、把繩梯架上城牆並在城內放火的貴族隊長，以及隨軍背扛糧秣、矛束與繩索的勞役隊。碑銘不為這些人留下名字，但從城邦的政治結構可以看出來：能決定勝負的，是能不能把聯軍送到對方城下，以及願不願意為一場星戰耗掉一整季的收成。
peopleEn: Few individuals can be named, and most of them come from the monuments. The attack was led by Caracol's lord of the three stones, that is the reigning monarch of the K'inich royal house; Chinese-language encyclopaedias list the rulers of this stretch as Tajoom Uk'ab' K'ak' (reigned about 622 to 630) and his successor Yuknoom Head (630 to 636), while epigraphers generally treat K'an Tok Wayib' as Caracol's best known ruler, a name whose reign spans the late 620s to the 680s and which is directly linked with the capture of Naranjo's king in 631. On the defending side sat the monarch of Naranjo's Itz'am K'an dynasty, whom scholarship usually identifies for the years 627 to 631 as Chak Tok Ich'aak I; the monuments keep only an abbreviated glyph and a royal headband for his name, while his image survives chiefly in the carved scene of Naranjo Stela 24. Two further kinds of person actually changed the course of events: the priestly colleges that conducted the star-war rites and fixed the moment for war to begin, and the royal elders who met outside the city to settle the list of allies, the share each would contribute, the division of spoils and the terms on which prisoners would be ransomed. Below them stood the noble captains who led the spear charges in the field, raised rope ladders against the walls and set fires inside the city, together with the porters who carried grain, bundles of darts and coils of rope behind the army. The monuments give none of these people a name, but the political structure of the city-states shows what mattered: whether the coalition could be brought under the enemy walls, and whether anyone was willing to spend a whole season's harvest on one star war.
kits: 卡面所列的中國弩（Chinese crossbow，約公元前二○○年）在本役並不出現：弩機、鋼鐵弩臂與金屬箭簇從未進入中美洲，六二七年的瑪雅戰場上沒有一具弩。與弩在功能上真正對應的是擲矛器（atlatl）與複合弓——同樣是先把力量存進器物、待戰機成熟才一次釋放，射速遠勝徒手拉弓，而這正是弩在東亞守城時最被看重的一點。瑪雅步兵的骨幹是佩槍突擊隊，槍杆削尖或嵌燧石、蛋白石片；弓手用木弓或複合弓，配骨製、燧石與黑曜石箭鏃；近戰兵用嵌黑曜石刃的木柄短劍（macuahuitl）；另有以投石索拋石的擲石手。護體靠纏裹棉布、獸皮背心與羽飾頭盔，圓盾以木框、柳條蒙皮再綴羽毛。攻城裝備包括木梯、繩索、可拆卸的棚架，以及成束的乾草與火種——瑪雅建築多為木構加茅頂，一經點燃極難撲救。全軍沒有可用的馭獸，糧秣、矛束與繩梯全靠人力背扛，渡科潘河與烏拉河改用小舟，燧石、棉布與陶器則就地取給。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow named on the card (Chinese crossbow, about 200 BC) did not appear in this war: the lock mechanism, the steel prod and the metal bolt never reached Mesoamerica, and there was not a single crossbow on a Maya battlefield in 627. What corresponds to the crossbow in function is the atlatl dart-thrower and the composite bow, which likewise store the force in a mechanism or a bow's limbs and release it all at once at the right moment, giving a rate of fire far beyond that of a hand-drawn bow, and that was exactly the quality for which the crossbow was prized in East Asian siege defence. The backbone of the Maya infantry was the spear-bearing assault companies, their hafts sharpened or fitted with chert and opisthalmite blades; archers used wooden or composite bows with bone, chert and obsidian points; close-combat men carried macuahuitl, wooden swords with obsidian blades set into the wood; and there were slingers who threw stones from leather loops. Protection came from layered cotton wrapping, jaguar-skin vests and feathered headgear, while round shields were wooden frames faced with lime-wood splints and decorated with feathers. The siege equipment consisted of wooden ladders, rope, knock-down scaffolding and bundles of dry grass and kindling, for Maya buildings were timber on thatched roofs, and once alight they were very hard to put out. The army had no draft animals at all: grain, darts and rope ladders were all carried on human backs, canoes were used to cross the Copan and Ulua rivers, and flint, cotton cloth and pottery were taken from the country as the column moved.
tactics: 這是一場標準的「星戰」（xul）遠征。開戰之前，卡拉科爾在城中的廣場上以星形紙符與束箭作儀，宣告對方城邦的「星戰」；宣告本身就是憑證，聯盟城邦據此取得出兵的名分與理由，拒絕者等於自認不戰。聯軍沿佩滕盆地的古道南下，經卡安努爾與貝里斯一帶的山徑越過分水嶺，進入科潘河谷；兩地直線相距約二百二十公里，實際繞行山道接近三百公里。攻略的關鍵在誘導與封鎖：聯軍派出小股前鋒挑釁，引納蘭霍的精銳出城追擊，主力則埋伏在谷地彎道、廢棄台地與林緣，同時封住通往尤卡坦與科潘的商道，使對方無法補充弓弦、燧石與陶罐。攻城時先用佩槍隊與擲矛手在城外把守軍壓在牆頭，逼其露出缺口，再由架梯組攀上城垣，在城內放火。城破之後，聯軍並不長久駐紮，而是按聯盟份額分割繳獲，焚燒公共建築與軍用設施，帶走王像、祭器與工匠，再沿原路退回。撤退次序與沿途水源是整場遠征能成立的另一個前提：沒有馭獸，也沒有輜重車，一步走錯就會被斷在谷中。
tacticsEn: This was a textbook star-war (xul) expedition. Before the fighting began, Caracol performed the rite in the plaza of the capital, with star-shaped paper bundles and arrows, and proclaimed a star war against the enemy city; the proclamation itself served as the warrant, for allied cities drew on it both as the reason and the licence to send troops, and a refusal to answer it was a confession of not fighting. The coalition marched south along the old roads of the Peten basin, took the mountain tracks past Kaanul and the Belize country, crossed the watershed and entered the Copan valley; the two cities lie about 220 kilometres apart in a straight line, but the column covered close to 300 kilometres of detoured mountain path. The plan turned on bait and blockade: a small vanguard went forward to provoke, drawing Naranjo's elite out of the city after them, while the main body waited in ambush at bends of the valley, on abandoned terraces and along the edge of the forest, and at the same time the road toward Uactun and Copan was closed so that the enemy could not replace bowstrings, flint or pots. At the walls, spear companies and dart throwers first pinned the defenders on the ramparts and forced them to show where the line was thin; ladder teams then climbed and set fires inside. Once the city was taken the coalition did not garrison it: the spoil was divided according to each member's share, the public buildings and military installations were burned, and the regalia, the offerings and the craftsmen were carried off before the column withdrew along the same road. The order of withdrawal and the water on the way back were the second precondition for the expedition's success: with no draft animals and no wagons, a single wrong turn in the valley meant being cut off there.
data: 可引的數字不多，而且多屬推算。距離：卡拉科爾在北緯十六度四十六分、格林威治西經八十九度七分附近，納蘭霍在北緯十四度四十八分、西經八十九度零二分附近，直線相距約二百二十公里，遠征軍實際繞行山道接近三百公里。時間：碑銘把這次星戰繫於公元六二七年，記下此事的納蘭霍第一碑則立於六三一年；起事月份在長紀年曆換算上仍有出入，此處取年末十二月為代表。規模：納蘭霍的城址與可耕台地的推估人口約在一萬上下，卡拉科爾的估算在相近量級；若聯盟各城以數百人計，遠征總兵力當在數千人至一萬之間，但碑刻不列名冊，這個區間只能當作量級看。碑刻本身可量的部分有限：納蘭霍第一碑高逾三公尺（各著錄略有出入），屬當地大型單石碑，碑面以縱排字記下日期與戰事，正面刻聯盟統帥與被擄者的形象。日期之所以能精確到日，靠的是加長紀年曆與哈布曆、卓爾金曆並用的紀時制度。
dataEn: Few figures can be quoted, and most of them are estimates. Distance: Caracol lies near 16 degrees 46 minutes north, 89 degrees 7 minutes west, Naranjo near 14 degrees 48 minutes north, 89 degrees 2 minutes west, about 220 kilometres apart in a straight line, and the expedition covered close to 300 kilometres of detoured mountain path. Time: the monuments tie this star war to AD 627, and Naranjo Stela 24, which records it, was erected in 631; the month of the outbreak still shifts under conversion of the Long Count, and the month of December is used here as a representative. Scale: the excavated area and cultivable terraces of Naranjo are estimated at a population of around ten thousand, and the estimate for Caracol is of the same order; if each allied city sent a few hundred men, the fielding force would have been in the thousands and perhaps as many as ten thousand, but the monuments keep no roster, so that range can only be read as an order of magnitude. What can be measured on the stone itself is limited: Naranjo Stela 24 stands more than three metres high, with some variation between the published records, and is a large single monument for the site; its text in vertical columns gives the dates and the events, and its carved face shows the commander of the coalition together with a captive. That dates could be fixed to the day depended on the use of the extended Long Count alongside the haab and the tzolkin calendars.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，碑刻沒有留下辯詞，只能由兩地的政治地理推想。納蘭霍自六世紀末起就是佩滕盆地向東南低地推鋒的城邦之一，其星戰遠征帶著掠奪與收編的目的，沿古道把勢力伸進科潘河谷與尤卡坦西部；沿線的村社要麼被拉進同盟，要麼被強迫交納貢物，拒絕者便可能成為星戰的目標。位於瑪雅山脈北麓的卡拉科爾，正是這條南向商道與黑曜石、可可貿易線的西端咽喉，其王室的正當性正建立在「能替南邊的盟友出頭」之上。於是推論有兩層：第一，納蘭霍的星戰或盟約條款牽連到卡拉科爾勢力範圍內的城社，邊界上的村社被對方重新編組或徵用；第二，在六二○年代後期，聯盟內部出現裂痕，納蘭霍一系不肯再承認卡拉科爾對這些城社的宗主地位。星戰一旦宣告，等於承認雙方之間已無仲裁可循，剩下的只有比兵員、比器械、比誰更能把聯軍送到對方城下。
causeEn: The monuments leave no argument for why this war began, so it can only be reconstructed from the political geography of the two cities. Since the late sixth century Naranjo had been one of the city-states pushing out of the Peten basin into the southeastern lowlands, its star wars carrying plunder and absorption with them as the line of power moved down the old roads into the Copan valley and western Uactun; villages along that line were either pulled into the coalition or forced to hand over tribute, and those who refused became candidates for a star war. Caracol, standing in the northern foothills of the Maya Mountains, sat exactly on the western throat of that southbound trade road and of the obsidian and cacao traffic, and the legitimacy of its royal house rested on being the power that could answer for its allies to the south. Two inferences follow. First, Naranjo's star wars, or the treaty clauses that went with them, reached into the city-states inside Caracol's sphere of influence, with border villages re-tasked or conscripted by the other side. Second, during the late 620s the coalition itself began to crack, and the Naranjo line refused any longer to acknowledge Caracol's overlordship over those communities. Once a star war is proclaimed, both sides have admitted that no arbiter remains between them, and nothing is left to compare except numbers, equipment and who can get a coalition under the enemy's walls.
impact: 這場仗的後果，寫在兩座城的下一代裡。納蘭霍的星戰體系被折斷：遠征之後，它在六二○年代累積的同盟與戰果變成別人的戰功，其君主在六三一年被生擒，一般認為並在祭祀中被殺（這一段多由卡拉科爾方面的紀錄保存），納蘭霍此後數十年在佩滕—科潘一帶的競爭中退居下風，碑刻序列一度中斷，要到八世紀才重新以強邦身分回到科潘河谷，並在山頂蓋起後來稱為「老虎神廟」的高台。卡拉科爾則把這場戰爭的成果轉成霸權：南向低地的城邦被納入聯盟或成為附庸，南方山地的黑曜石與可可流向被它壟斷，「三人石」標誌開始出現在遠離本土的碑刻上。戰術層面的影響同樣長久：把聯盟遠征與星戰宣告做成一整套儀式化的國家行為，並以「奪王」作為勝利的標誌，這套做法在此後兩百年裡為佩滕盆地的多個城邦沿用。對參戰的兵員而言，遠征意味著數月的口糧、衣物與器械損耗，而沒有馭獸與輜重，所有這一切都只能由村社分攤。
impactEn: The consequences of this war are written into the next generation of both cities. Naranjo's system of star wars was broken: after the expedition, the alliances and the war results it had accumulated through the 620s became another city's war honours, its king was taken alive in 631 and is generally believed to have been killed in sacrifice, a detail preserved chiefly in Caracol's own records; Naranjo then fell back in the competition over Peten and Copan for the following decades, its monument sequence interrupting, and it did not return to the Copan valley as a strong polity until the eighth century, when it raised the high platform on the summit later called the Temple of the Jaguar. Caracol, by contrast, turned the outcome into hegemony: the lowland cities of the south were taken into the coalition or made tributaries, the flow of obsidian and cacao from the southern mountains came under its grip, and the three-stone emblem began to appear on monuments far from its own homeland. The tactical legacy was just as durable: turning the coalition expedition and the star-war proclamation into a single ritualised act of state, and taking the enemy king as the sign of victory, was a practice that other Peten cities kept for the next two hundred years. For the soldiers who marched, the expedition meant months of rations, of worn clothing and of damaged equipment, and with no draft animals and no wagons all of that had to be apportioned among the villages.
result: 結果是進攻方的完勝，但並非一場速戰速決的殲滅戰。聯盟軍在谷地殲滅納蘭霍出城迎戰的主力，攻破並焚燒城內關鍵建築，奪走王像與禮器，其國王的威信在聯盟內部被徹底粉碎。納蘭霍的城邦沒有被抹去，卻在接下來二十多年裡淪為附庸與附屬，六三一年君主被俘殺後，它的政治生命實際上中斷；其城址要等上一百五十年，才在八世紀重新長成足以與鄰邦角力的強者。卡拉科爾自此把勢力推到科潘河谷東緣，「三人石之主」的名號由一個地方王號變成區域性的宗主稱號，中美洲低地東南部的權力重心也由佩滕盆地移向貝里斯山脈。這場戰爭沒有留下兵員與損失的數字，我們只知道它的規模足以讓多個城邦同時出兵，也知道它的後果足以改變數十年的區域格局：納蘭霍此後兩個半世紀都在別人的陰影下重新學走路。
resultEn: The result was a complete victory for the attackers, though not the annihilation of a single afternoon. The coalition destroyed Naranjo's field army in the valley, broke into the city and burned its principal buildings, and carried off the regalia and the ritual objects; the authority of the king was shattered inside the coalition itself. Naranjo was not erased: for more than twenty years it sank to the status of a tributary and an appendage, and after the capture and killing of its king in 631 its political life was effectively interrupted, its site needing another hundred and fifty years before it grew back into a power able to contest its neighbours in the eighth century. Caracol pushed its reach to the eastern rim of the Copan valley; the title of lord of the three stones ceased to be a local royal name and became a regional overlordship, and the centre of gravity in the southeastern lowlands of Mesoamerica shifted from the Peten basin to the Belize mountains. No headcounts or loss figures survive for this war; what is known is that its scale was great enough for several cities to field troops at once, and that its consequences were great enough to rearrange the regional order of power for decades. Naranjo spent the next two and a half centuries relearning how to walk in another city's shadow.
